card.name: Start of IN- route words
card.fires_on: The piece "IN" or "-in" that begins a route or product word such as intravenous, intramuscular, injection, inhaled or Intron, mostly in capitals after "and", "or" or "non-".

modes.label: Capital IN in route words
modes.description: Capitalized IN starting a word like INTRAVENOUS, INJECTION or INTRAMUSCULAR in headings.
modes.example: WARNING - HYPERSENSITIVITY REACTIONS WITH INTRAVENOUS AND<< IN>>TRAMUSCULAR USE Fatal hypers

modes.label: Non-intravenous
modes.description: The "-in" after "non" that starts "intravenous" in a hyphenated route phrase.
modes.example: The risk of administering methylene blue by non<<-in>>travenous routes (such as oral tablets

card.writes: It pushes the model toward finishing the word as inject or injection forms.
card.plain: It fires on the opening "IN" of words like intravenous or injection, when the word is split up.
